Bestiary - Dungeon Monsters Kit
August 2026
The Bestiary - Dungeon Monsters Kit includes 7 different game-ready enemy models with weapons, each with 3 different color variations, rigged with a Humanoid rig allowing easy retargeting in any engine and with optimized low poly topology.
Features
7 Monsters.
3 Color texture variations per monster.
Optimized and low poly animation-friendly topology.
Humanoid Rig compatible with retargeting in any engine.
Compatible with the Universal Animation Library.
Free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects.
.FBX and .GLB formats, compatible with all engines.
Made possible by Patreon supporters
